narr: A broken line of strong to severe thunderstorms tracked northeast across Weld County during the afternoon hours. Heavy rain and small hail were common with isolated strong winds and minor flooding reported.
ev: Water was running over Weld County Road 29. The water depth was 10 to 12 inches and spanned 75 yards.
lsr: Water (75 yards wide and 10 to 12 inches deep) was running over Weld Country Road 29.
